title: Authenticating Users with Active Directory Federation Services

facts.text: Active Directory Federation Services must be installed and accessible via public URL from the server running Business Central Server.
Business Central deployment requires Server, Web server configured with SSL, and optionally Windows client and admin tools.
Deployment must be configured with security certificates to secure remote connections.
Create a Relying Party Trust in AD FS for Web or Windows client separately, specifying the client URL and a unique trust identifier.
Set up claim rules in AD FS for either SAML tokens with name and objectidentifier claims, or JWT tokens with equivalent custom rules.
Configure Server credential type to NavUserPassword or AccessControlService, set federation metadata location, and configure login endpoints for each client type.
Map Business Central users to AD FS accounts by setting Authentication Email field to user's UPN, starting in Inactive status until first sign-in.
Web server must be reconfigured to use AccessControlService credential type in navsettings.json file, picked up automatically by IIS.
